clip: (()=>{const f=(t)=>[...document.querySelectorAll('h2,h3,div,span,p')].find(e=>e.children.length===0&&e.textContent.trim().toUpperCase().startsWith(t));const card=(e)=>{let n=e;while(n&&!(getComputedStyle(n).borderTopWidth!=='0px'&&n.getBoundingClientRect().width>400))n=n.parentElement;return n;};const a=card(f('CLUSTER RESOURCE USAGE')).getBoundingClientRect(),b=card(f('HOST LOAD')).getBoundingClientRect();const x=Math.min(a.x,b.x)-12,y=a.y-12;return {x,y,width:Math.max(a.right,b.right)-x+12,height:b.bottom-y+12};})()
